changelog:
v3.7.1 — Clearer Error Messages

When playback fails, the app now tells you what actually happened and what to do, instead of a generic "Playback error."

• Access denied (HTTP 401/403) — says to contact your provider about your subscription
• Too many connections (HTTP 409/429) — says to close Ooustream on your other devices
• Title not found (404) — specific, not generic
• Server is having issues (5xx) — distinguishes server problems from your connection
• SSL/TLS failures — suggests checking your device's date and time (usually the actual fix)
• DNS failures — suggests checking your WiFi or DNS settings
• Connection refused, socket timeout — each gets its own message

Debug logs now capture the HTTP status code, response message, and server hostname on every failed stream, so customer reports are actionable without needing a debug build.
